title: Oily Velvety Greek Lentil Baklava
description: A mustardy, velvety, and savory Greek dish featuring lentils, sake, and a mortar-pestle-pound technique, served in a donabe vessel, perfect as a hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar, pound the mustard seeds and garlic until well combined.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the lentils, sake, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the pounded mustard seed mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Layer the phyllo dough in a donabe vessel, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Spoon the lentil mixture into the phyllo dough layers, creating a baklava shape.
Bake the baklava in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until golden brown.
